prior_transcript.speaker: other
prior_transcript.text: My Eave cam on the garage has dropped offline again. The app's telling me the battery is at twelve percent.

prior_transcript.speaker: user
prior_transcript.text: Thanks. I can see on my side that it was last online yesterday evening.

oracle.expected_behavior_note: The answer hangs on the twelve percent said a moment earlier. The troubleshooting guide says an Eave Cam needs its battery above 15% to reconnect, so at 12% it will stay offline until it is charged; nothing suggests a fault. The reply tells the customer to charge it (indoors if it is freezing, because it will not charge below 0 C) and that it should come back once it is above 15%. No factory reset, no replacement, no escalation at this point.

The customer said the battery is at twelve percent.

optional_facts.text: It will not charge below 0 C, so bring it indoors to charge in cold weather.

Escalates to Tier 2 before the battery has been charged.

acceptable_inference: Mentioning that a full charge normally lasts 4 to 6 months.
